status_policy: Every item in this registry is an engineering purchasing and qualification candidate only.
A vendor specification, nominal calculation, digital fit, or source link is not physical qualification or customer release authority.
Only controlled physical evidence may promote a selected item through the existing measurement, lifecycle, commissioning, and release workflows.
Alternative candidates are not interchangeable until one complete configuration is selected and qualified.

fastener_stack_screening.method: Nominal thread engagement = screw length - effective printed screw-seat stack - washer thickness - (board thickness - insert reach into board).
physical_acceptance: Measure the received board, insert, washer, screw, and cooled printed seat rather than accepting nominal values.
Require at least 5.0 mm actual thread engagement at all nine locations.
Require no insert or screw bottoming and no underside projection.
Tighten dry with one flat washer at 0.30 N m using the qualified preset driver, then apply a witness mark.

candidate_placement_mm.board_coordinate_system: Origin at board front-left; +Y toward rear edge and robot.

screening_notes: The candidate remains inside the current x=225-385 mm clamp zone with about 3.8 mm side margin.
Its front edge is 75.5 mm behind the nearest current board-anchor center at y=254.5 mm.
These coordinate checks do not prove coverage of the received clamp pad, board flatness, slip resistance, or clamp preload.

camera_architecture_boundary.camera: Arducam B0477 with nominal 16 mm lens; received unit unverified
camera_architecture_boundary.support: independent commercial floor tripod ASIN B0CSYB4YQ2
camera_architecture_boundary.boundary_note: The selected tripod is planning scope only. Received identity, mount, pose, stability, visibility, collision, and wrong-model evidence remain required before installation or motion.

route_scope_snapshot.boundary_note: The two tool routes are selected and the fixed-mast camera fallback is unselected. The exact passive stylus remains an open candidate decision, and this registry does not change route authority or provide qualification evidence.

limitations: The layout defines only a rear clamp zone, not the robot base-axis position or a full board-to-base transform.
A maximum workspace envelope is not proof that an oriented approach, contact, and retreat pose is reachable without collision or singularity.
The published repeatability is approximately plus or minus 5 mm, much larger than the intended fixture repeatability; vision correction and compliant contact remain required.
The 0.2 kg at 0.5 m payload must include the tool, adapter, moving mass, and cable drag.
required_release_evidence: Freeze and measure the installed clamp edge-to-base-axis offset and full T_board_base transform: x, y, z, roll, pitch, and yaw.
Record robot and clamp revisions, table and board planes, clamp deflection, physical joint-zero calibration, and uncertainty.
Define the custom tool TCP transform, total moving mass, center of mass, cable load, and collision geometry.
Run inverse kinematics for every approach, contact, and retreat pose with joint-limit, singularity, payload, and collision margins.
Complete reduced-speed physical empty-cell sweeps before compliant, force-limited first contact.

candidates.description: E-Z Hex flanged zinc-alloy threaded insert for wood

spec.candidate_installation: Underside installation with flange seated against the underside of the exact sealed 18 mm plywood.

qualification_gates.requirement: Verify received MPN, thread, dimensions, lot, and installation tool.
Section exact sealed-board interior and 21.2 mm edge-location coupons; reject veneer breakout, delamination, tilt, or flange stand-off.
Complete service cycles at 0.30 N m and a 50 N axial proof for 60 seconds without rotation, pullout, damage, or migration.

caveats: The manufacturer states drill requirements vary by application; 15/64 inch is a starting candidate, not a released board process.
Do not impact-drive and do not drill the production board until coupon evidence is accepted.

candidates.description: Ten-insert installation kit with drill and installation tool

qualification_gates.requirement: Inventory the supplied drill and tool and verify they install the received inserts square without impact driving.

caveats: One kit does not provide enough inserts for nine installed anchors, three customer spares, and destructive engineering coupons.

candidates.description: M4 x 20 mm A2 stainless ISO 7380-1 button-head socket screw

qualification_gates.requirement: Measure length, thread, head, and drive on the received lot.
Prove the four nominal 4 mm station stacks achieve at least 5 mm engagement with no bottoming or underside projection.

caveats: The two shared keyboard clamp locations may use this common button-head approach only after driver access and clamp preload are qualified.

candidates.description: M4 x 25 mm A2 stainless ISO 7380-1 button-head socket screw

qualification_gates.requirement: Measure length, thread, head, and drive on the received lot.
Prove the four nominal 8 mm stacks and corrected TCP stack achieve at least 5 mm engagement with no bottoming or projection.

caveats: The current TCP geometry retains a 10.5 mm island but applies a 1.5 mm washer recess, producing a 9.0 mm effective seat in the regenerated digital artifacts.
Digital exact-fit evidence does not qualify received screws, washers, inserts, board stock, or printed geometry.

candidates.description: M4 A2 stainless DIN 125A flat washer

qualification_gates.requirement: Measure ID, OD, and thickness on the received lot.
Verify flat seating and tool clearance in every applicable printed recess.

caveats: Use exactly one flat washer per station screw; no lock washer or threadlocker is part of this candidate stack.

candidates.description: Series 7400 preset torque screwdriver configured to 0.30 N m

qualification_gates.requirement: Verify exact part number, current calibration evidence, and preset locking.
Demonstrate repeatable 0.30 N m station assembly without insert rotation or print damage.

caveats: A preset tool does not replace anchor and printed-stack proof testing.

candidates.description: 2.5 mm Hex-Plus driver bit

spec.interface: Compatible with the selected Wera torque-driver chuck

qualification_gates.requirement: Verify full drive engagement without cam-out or head damage on both selected screw lengths.

candidates.manufacturer: Seller-supplied custom part; candidate fabricator SendCutSend
candidates.description: Precut deburred 6061-T6 underside reinforcement plate

spec.edge_condition: Deburr both faces; break edges 0.25-0.5 mm

qualification_gates.requirement: Verify material certification or order record, dimensions, flatness, edge condition, and absence of rocking.
Measure the received RoArm clamp pad and retain at least 10 mm pad-to-plate-edge margin.
Record board flatness, crushing, clamp slip, and 24-hour and 7-day creep with the final clamp method.

caveats: The factory clamp remains the load-bearing interface; the plate only spreads underside load.
Do not place unqualified foam in the clamp pressure path.

candidates.description: Adhesive-backed square polyurethane Bumpon feet

qualification_gates.requirement: Freeze a placement that clears the plate, anchors, tags, cables, and bench edge.
Verify support, adhesion, compression, and board shift under worst-case robot motion.

caveats: Feet are not a proven anti-shift restraint; mechanical bench clamping remains mandatory if the motion test shows movement.

candidates.description: Prewired magnetic paddle power cutoff with standard cords

spec.cord: 14 AWG SJT, three-prong male and female
spec.candidate_connection_order: Wall receptacle to POWERTEC 71755 to received Waveshare 12 V / 5 A power adapter to RoArm.

qualification_gates.requirement: Verify the received device label, cords, grounding, ratings, condition, and exact RoArm power-supply input.
Measure power removal, stop time, residual travel, gravity drop, USB back-power, and access from every operator position.
Verify no automatic re-energization after cutoff reset or mains interruption in ten consecutive trials.

caveats: This is a prototype emergency power-off candidate, not a safety-rated emergency-stop system.
No published performance level, stop category, STO function, or system stop-time claim has been established for the RoArm application.

candidates.description: Quote-configured industrial anti-restart and E-stop system direction

spec.candidate_connectors: NEMA 5-15P input and NEMA 5-15R output requested
spec.candidate_configuration: Prewired enclosed upstream power control for the exact received Waveshare power adapter and controller load.
spec.published_product_family_approvals: UL 508A industrial control panel; CSA #14-13 industrial control equipment

qualification_gates.requirement: Obtain written manufacturer approval and exact quoted configuration for the received switching power supply and always-on digital RoArm controller.
Have a competent reviewer confirm required channels, stop category, reset behavior, diagnostics, connector retention, and risk-reduction claim.
Repeat stop, drop, USB back-power, anti-restart, bypass, and automatic-middle-on-power-up tests in the final system.

caveats: The published IRE manual assumes an existing machine off/run control and uses machine-switch detection; RoArm compatibility is not established.
Do not purchase, install, or describe this as the selected V1 system without written application approval and a completed system risk assessment.

candidates.description: Enclosed AR0234 color global-shutter USB3 UVC camera

qualification_gates.requirement: Prove sharp, stable focus at the final 400-600 mm working distance.
Acquire at least 30 ChArUco views, accept at least 20, and achieve RMS reprojection error no greater than 1 pixel.
Detect all six tags in 20 of 20 required trials with locked focus, exposure, and white balance.

caveats: The default published focus range does not cover the intended close working distance; close focus is a physical gate.
The product page and B0495 datasheet publish different FOV values; keep the values source-scoped and use the smaller 82 degree horizontal by 66 degree vertical pair for preliminary framing.
The calculated field of view is screening only and does not prove calibration, lighting, or occlusion performance.

candidates.description: C920e Business Webcam

spec.mount: Integrated tripod thread; usable blind depth unpublished

qualification_gates.requirement: Measure the camera, usable blind thread depth, and a non-bottoming retention stack.
Prove focus and exposure settings remain controlled after disconnect, reconnect, and application restart.
Prove calibrated coverage and all-six-tag detection in every required pose.

caveats: This remains an alternative to the global-shutter candidate; do not combine camera-specific calibration evidence.

candidates.description: Desktop overhead photography and live-streaming bracket

spec.mounting_boundary: Clamp independently to the bench behind the board and outside the robot sweep.

qualification_gates.requirement: Verify the exact bench edge and thickness, clamp retention, camera fastener engagement, and a secondary safety tether.
Measure sag, cable disturbance, 24-hour drift, and remove/reinstall calibration recovery.
Demonstrate support, camera, tether, and service-loop clearance from every approved robot path.

caveats: This is consumer photographic support hardware, not a released metrology frame.
If drift or collision clearance fails, use a separately qualified rigid stand.

candidates.description: Paired mast candidate using exact 80/20 20-2020 extrusion

spec.extrusion_profile: 20 mm x 20 mm, four open slots, 6063-T6 clear anodized
spec.architecture: Independent from robot and board vibration path

qualification_gates.requirement: Select exact extrusion, brackets, T-nuts, M5 hardware, base attachment, ASA SKU, and camera retention before purchase release.
Qualify extrusion fit, feet, bolt stacks, crossbar level, base retention, static rigidity, disturbance recovery, and 24-hour drift.

caveats: The extrusion is exact, but the complete support is not: brackets, T-nuts, base anchors, fastener lengths, support base, ASA SKU, and supplier cut tolerances remain unresolved.
It does not select measurement_record camera_mast_optional.

candidates.description: QIDI PETG-Tough filament, black

spec.candidate_printer: QIDI Plus4 with standard 0.4 mm nozzle

qualification_gates.requirement: Record exact SKU, color, spool lot, drying history, storage, printer serial, firmware, nozzle, plate side, and QIDI Studio/profile version.
Qualify verification coupons, dimensional features, holes, inserts, nut captures, bridges, first layer, warp, and support removal.
Complete two consecutive full accepted print sets and 24-hour and 7-day fixture creep checks without profile or CAD changes.

caveats: Dry before qualification according to the manufacturer guidance.
The exact customer spool quantity must be established from accepted slicer mass plus scrap and spare allowance.

candidates.description: QIDI TPU95A-HF filament, black, 1 kg

spec.candidate_printer: QIDI Plus4 with standard 0.4 mm nozzle

qualification_gates.requirement: Record exact SKU, color, lot, drying history, storage, feed route, printer, firmware, nozzle, and frozen profile.
Qualify dimensional fit, pull-off, compression set, creep, cycle wear, and device-contact performance.

caveats: Use the physically qualified feed route; do not assume an accessory material box is suitable for TPU.

candidates.description: USB Type-A, English-US, black compact keyboard candidate

qualification_gates.requirement: Confirm exact label, layout, cable, connector, underside feet, key field, and full envelope.
Prove retention, datum repeatability, cable clearance, required key actuation, and repeated removal without housing distortion.

caveats: No other PERIBOARD-409 connector or regional-layout variant is compatible without separate evidence.

candidates.description: Galaxy A16 5G bare-phone candidate

qualification_gates.requirement: Confirm exact regional model and measure body, buttons, glass edge, camera bump, USB-C port, and installed orientation.
Complete clamp, no-go, cable, device-function, damage, and repeated insertion/removal tests.

caveats: This full order code is a UK reference variant; it cannot become a US commercial reference without a regional decision and physical comparison.
A case is outside this V1 candidate and requires a separate geometry and compatibility configuration.

candidates.description: One-meter right-angle USB-C to straight USB-C cable

qualification_gates.requirement: Verify part number, connector direction, connector bodies, overall length, and cable OD.
Prove the intended host and power function, relaxed bend, service loop, docking cycles, strain relief, and zero lateral phone-port load.

caveats: The manufacturer does not publish the installed bend radius needed by this fixture; it must be measured.
Manufacturer-direct US stock was reported as unavailable during the candidate review; qualify a traceable reseller source or alternate before release.

candidates.description: Lite Pressure Type 316 stainless compression spring

qualification_gates.requirement: Measure OD, ID or work-over-rod clearance, free length, wire, solid height, and lot force-rate curve.
Prove 1-6 mm travel, preload, no coil bind, no guide rub, full return, creep, and approved contact force.

caveats: Calculated incremental load excludes assembly preload, friction, tolerances, off-axis forces, and tool mass.
Reject or redesign if the final contact-force envelope cannot be met.

candidates.description: Six-millimeter by 100-millimeter unhardened 303 stainless precision shaft

qualification_gates.requirement: Measure diameter at several locations, length, straightness, end condition, mass, and surface condition.
Deburr safely and prove printed-bushing retention, TPU pull-off, 24-hour creep, cycle wear, keyboard function, spring travel, and TCP repeatability.

caveats: This exact SKU is a proposed replacement for the prior generic 6 mm by 90-110 mm rod purchasing description only after physical qualification and controlled configuration selection.
No canonical route or CAD parameter is changed by listing it here.

candidates.description: Five-plus-one degree-of-freedom serial robot arm with factory table clamp

spec.power_supply_output: 12 V / 5 A nominal; verify received label and AC input

qualification_gates.requirement: Record exact robot, controller, clamp, firmware, power-adapter, and connector revisions.
Measure T_board_base and tool TCP with uncertainty; validate the official model against physical joint zeros.
Complete IK, payload, singularity, collision, empty-cell, and compliant first-contact evidence for every released path.

caveats: Waveshare warns the arm moves joints toward a middle pose at power-on.
No documented safety-rated STO or emergency-stop input has been established for this product configuration.
